page_content: Use the password reset link on the sign-in page. The email normally arrives within five minutes, and each link expires after one hour; request a new link if it has expired.
Dark mode is available in the web application under Profile, Appearance. Mobile dark mode remains a tracked feature request with no committed delivery date.
For a desktop crash after sign-in, capture the application version and correlation code, restart once, and attach the sanitized diagnostic bundle to the support ticket.
Email notification preferences are managed under Profile, Notifications. Security alerts cannot be disabled.
Tenant Alpha administrators can export an audit report from Administration, Audit, Export after selecting a bounded date range.
Tenant Beta uses a private bulk-export workflow that must never appear in another tenant's response.
Retired password reset instructions with an obsolete twenty-four-hour link.
